description: Valid and broken settings zips, each with the verdict an import must give. An entry is {name, text}, {name, dir: true}, {name, text, duplicate: true} (the name appears twice), {nameHex, text} (a name that is not UTF-8) or {name, raw} for a whole file that is not a zip. A verdict is {read: [kind/id, ...]} or {refused: {entry, reason}} with a piece of the sentence. The app's tests and the checker of run 4 run the same file.
